subject: Attributed functional convergence of the 2011 Sun Park claimant/Community perimeter into the later Acosta Matos/CAM perimeter

controlled_meaning: convergence of Community, corporate, title, voting, creditor and project capacities
adoption or use of earlier Community machinery by later actors
possible transmission of knowledge through continuing actors
excluded_meaning: automatic transfer of knowledge or criminal intent

grades.DIRECT_DOCUMENTARY: Primary, official or controlled records directly establish the stated relationship or transition.
grades.STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_FUNCTIONAL: Multiple dated records support continuity of function, representation or implementation, but legal succession or purpose remains open.
grades.ATTRIBUTED_INFERENCE: Gil or another declarant alleges continuity or common purpose; independent corroboration is incomplete.
grades.OPEN_NOT_LOCATED: A material relationship, handover, instruction or shared purpose has not been located.

edges.proposition: Campanario represented much of the later claimant perimeter, acted as secretary of the 2-Feb-2011 meeting and proposed procedural strategy while Aizpurúa was appointed/elected president.
edges.limit: No unlawful agreement or later Acosta Matos link is proved by the meeting roles alone.

edges.proposition: Prieto represented Aizpurúa/Roque Prieto in the controlled 2014 Community record and later appeared on the Community/Molina side.
edges.limit: No universal or indefinite mandate is inferred.

edges.proposition: Prieto and López Noriega were professional partners and joint administrators of MILLAN AND MINERS, S.L.P.
edges.limit: The company link does not identify every client, matter, knowledge state or purpose.

edges.proposition: Prieto was an initial several administrator and later attorney-in-fact of SANTA LUCIA REAL ESTATE.
edges.limit: No Sun Park act by the company is established.

edges.proposition: Antonio was an initial several administrator, later sole administrator, of SANTA LUCIA REAL ESTATE alongside the Prieto bridge.
edges.limit: Corporate overlap does not prove joint instruction or criminal purpose.

edges.proposition: Antonio was the initial sole administrator of PAMALEXSHA; the Sun Park record later identifies Pamalexsha in Community administration functions.
edges.limit: Each Sun Park contract and act remains to be proved.

edges.proposition: Antonio was the initial sole administrator of EXPLOTACIONES NOALPA.
edges.limit: No direct Noalpa operation at Sun Park has been located.

edges.proposition: Community documentation transitions from Pamanil functions/communications to a Pamalexsha administration budget and later administrative references.
edges.limit: No merger, universal succession or complete transfer of files, funds, keys or contracts is proved.

edges.proposition: FMMM is documented in Community/Pamanil administration from 2011 and in later communications.
edges.limit: Act-specific powers and contractual scope remain necessary.

edges.proposition: FMMM's Community-administration continuity persists when Pamalexsha appears as the administration-services vehicle.
edges.limit: No FMMM corporate office in Pamalexsha or legal succession is proved.

edges.proposition: Shaila and FMMM appear as signatories/actors in the 2014 Pamanil/Community communications perimeter.
edges.limit: A communication does not establish universal authority or shared intent.

edges.proposition: A later official power to Shaila in Pamalexsha was registered in 2026.
edges.limit: The 2026 power cannot be backdated to 2011-2018.

edges.proposition: A power to Shaila in Noalpa was registered in 2021.
edges.limit: The power does not prove an earlier Sun Park role.

edges.proposition: The AMENEM/TENGOLF claimant lineage reappears in the 2018 vote/title chain; a traced formerly TENGOLF/AMENEM unit transferred to CAM immediately before the 7-Jun-2018 event.
edges.limit: Finca-specific continuity does not establish a universal claimant-to-CAM transfer or CAM direction of the 2011 case.

edges.proposition: FMMM continued as Community secretary-administrator through the 2017-2018 security/access and later CAM project stages.
edges.limit: Continuity of office does not establish original criminal intent or every alleged instruction.

edges.proposition: Antonio's Community presidency and the 2017-2018 voting/security structure intersected with CAM's creditor/title/access route.
edges.limit: Exact title, authority and command chain remain actor- and date-specific.

edges.proposition: The AC requested or used Community security/access implementation, relied on Community-generated debt material and later CAM relied on the same architecture inside the concurso.
edges.limit: This supports an enablement/adoption investigation, not automatic membership in the private Acosta Matos perimeter or criminal concert.

edges.proposition: JDAM/LPAM are the named natural-person axis of later CAM instruction, access/control and project allegations.
edges.limit: Each instruction, presence, mandate, knowledge state and responsibility remains independently provable.

edges.proposition: Official 2024 records identify FMMM with JDAM on the ORION board and as an AGM CANARY ASSET MANAGEMENT power-holder.
edges.limit: Later corporate office does not prove historic Sun Park criminal coordination.

edges.proposition: The later Acosta Matos/CAM axis is documented through RICPE project, HNT title and MYND operation layers.
edges.limit: Distinct companies and financing instruments remain separate; project continuity is not automatic co-authorship.

edges.proposition: A direct Campanario-to-CAM/Acosta Matos mandate, instruction, company or handover has not been located.
edges.limit: Historic role continuity cannot substitute for the missing later bridge.

edges.proposition: López is linked to the Community side and to Prieto; the direct Acosta Matos bridge is inferred through Prieto rather than independently established.
edges.limit: No direct Acosta company, mandate or instruction has been located for López.

core_inference: Multiple independent bridges support a substantial functional-convergence investigation. The map does not establish universal absorption, automatic knowledge transfer or a single continuous criminal agreement.
